name: Coil
tagline: Loop a trail around the orbs. Best score lives in the file.
description:
Works offline, no account, and the high score is saved inside this GIF — close it, copy it, the number comes with the file.

Drag a glowing trail with a finger or the mouse. Wrap it around the blue orbs before they burst. Catch several in one loop and the multiplier climbs. Red orbs are bombs: looping one costs energy. Energy hitting zero ends the run.

An unofficial port of Coil by Hakim El Hattab, MIT-licensed.
